caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical container with a slightly flared base and a round, flat lid, placed against a plain, light beige background. The container is primarily orange with decorative patterns in yellow, green, and black. The lid features a central floral or leaf-like design in yellow and green, with a small circular brownish element at the center. Around the body of the container, there are yellow decorative swags and drops as well as a yellow band encircling the top edge. A similar yellow band runs along the bottom edge of the container. The overall composition centers the container on the page, with no additional objects or elements present. The artist’s signature, "c. Herring," appears towards the lower left corner.
title: Toleware Sugar Bowl
